reviewItem.question: Does "If you have configured `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` or its YAML setting: - If it matches the value of `object_store` for all the periods that use…" mean a change to cli-flag:loki|name=-boltdb.shipper.shared-store (removed)?

proposed.statement: The `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` configuration option and its YAML setting have been removed; operators lose access to indexes for periods where the old value does not match `object_store`.
